details:
Red Hat Lightwell has released org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-http 12.0.32.rhlw-00002 with a backported security fix.

CVE-2026-2332: In Eclipse Jetty, the HTTP/1.1 parser is vulnerable to request smuggling when chunk extensions are used, similar to the "funky chunks" techniques outlined here:
  *  https://w4ke.info/2025/06/18/funky-chunks.html

  *  https://w4ke.info/2025/10/29/funky-chunks-2.html


Jetty terminates chunk extension parsing at \r\n inside quoted strings instead of treating this as an error.


POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

1;ext="val
X
0

GET /smuggled HTTP/1.1
...





Note how the chunk extension does not close the double quotes, and it is able to inject a smuggled request.

This patched artifact is a drop-in replacement for org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-http 12.0.32 from Maven Central.
